dt_clamp: dt >= 0 (config time_step_limit), prompt and decode paths
kv_cache: fp8 e4m3, one fp32 scale per (position, kv head); target attention layers
prompt_activations: routed and shared experts NVFP4 W4A4 (static input_scale, UE4M3 per 16 values); FP8-weight GEMMs FP8 E4M3 with per-row scales; BF16-weight GEMMs FP16 tensor cores; FP32 accumulation everywhere
recurrent_state: fp32 Mamba-2 state and conv window
routed_experts: pinned host records (63 GB), device slot cache: own VRAM after a 1.5 GiB margin, the prompt workspace between prompts and KV positions beyond the request; 60% of each decode pass's misses computed on the CPU
weights: as stored: fp8 per-tensor (Mamba in/out, attention, lm_head), nvfp4 group-16 (routed and shared experts), bf16 (router, latent projections, embeddings, drafter attention)
